title: store-devices.json
description: The devices enrolled for the project's private store (design 0003, sections 5 and 6): each machine or cloud environment that may push the store, with its age X25519 public key. A device's request is this document with one device, at proposals/<name>.json on the store repository's hitld-devices branch, put there by hitld store device init. A request is never trusted by itself: the devices a push is encrypted to are the ones the owner's own answers approved, recorded inside the encrypted store. Never in the project's repository: the commit guard refuses .human-in-the-lead/store-devices.json. It holds public keys only.

devices.description: The enrolled devices, sorted by name. Names and public keys are each unique.

name.description: The device's name: lower-case letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', at most 64 characters. A laptop's host name, or a name for a cloud environment.

recipient.description: The device's age X25519 public key (age1...). Its private key never leaves the device: the operating system's keychain on a local machine, an environment variable in a cloud environment.

added.description: The day the key pair was made, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC).
